actors.name: Developer
actors.description: Analyzes codebases, inspects interactive architecture diagrams, and runs analysis workflows via CLI or desktop app.

actors.name: LLM Provider
actors.description: Provides language model services to enrich parsed codebase metadata with high-level summaries and insights.

useCases.name: Analyze Codebase
useCases.description: Parses repository source files, framework structures, and Git history into an architectural domain model.

useCases.name: Generate Architecture Diagram
useCases.description: Transforms analyzed codebase domain models into visual diagram structures.

useCases.name: View Interactive Diagram
useCases.description: Renders visual architecture diagrams within the desktop application and diagram UI components.

useCases.name: Export Diagram
useCases.description: Exports generated architectural diagrams into external file formats.

useCases.name: Enrich Model with LLM
useCases.description: Enhances parsed codebase metadata using external AI models for deeper semantic understanding.

useCases.name: Run CLI Command
useCases.description: Executes analysis, diagram generation, and export operations directly from the terminal.

useCases.name: Collect Telemetry
useCases.description: Gathers anonymous diagnostics and usage metrics during application execution.

overview: Kratai is a codebase analysis and architectural diagram generation tool available as a CLI and Desktop application. It parses source code repositories and Git history, enriches metadata using LLMs, and renders interactive architectural diagrams.

nfrs.name: Parser Extensibility
nfrs.text: The parsing engine must maintain modular support for extensible language syntax and framework rules.

nfrs.name: LLM Failure Resilience
nfrs.text: Enrichment calls to external LLM providers must gracefully handle API latency and failure without interrupting base parsing.

nfrs.name: Non-Intrusive Telemetry
nfrs.text: Telemetry collection must operate asynchronously and respect user configuration and privacy settings.
